positions.name: IntakePantryNovemberRoutines
positions.frame: how will the intake rota and the pantry restocking routine run, and from when do they take effect?
positions.why: Priya's rota change (fortnightly, with a fifteen-minute overlap call at each hand-off) and Dario's restock rule (any shelf below a third full) are both operating routines for the same team. Priya's 'Both start on the first of November' ties the two into one start date. The set holds one frame: how the routines run and when they begin. The rota is a planned change and the restock rule is a standing one, but the shared start date reads them together without tension.
